# fornex_domain (Resource)

Provides a Fornex domain resource. This can be used to create and delete domains on Fornex DNS.

Fornex's `POST /dns/domain/` requires an `ip` and seeds a default zone template (A records for `""`, `*`, `www`, `mail` plus `MX "" -> "mail"`). The provider sends a placeholder IP and immediately deletes those auto-created records so Terraform is the sole source of truth for the zone contents; only `NS` and `SOA` records (owned by Fornex) are kept.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The domain name to manage.
